That sounds exhausting, and I'm sorry you've been carrying it for months. Before you do anything tomorrow, can we talk tonight? Not to talk you out of it, just to think it through together, things like money, what you'd say, whether there's a version of this where you leave on your terms instead of in a bad moment. If it's truly this bad, quitting might be the right call. I just want it to be a decision, not a reaction. Call me whenever.

## 2

I get why the space photos feel like the weak link, images can be faked, and trusting an institution you can't personally verify is a big ask. But the shape of the Earth isn't resting on NASA photos alone. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon. Time zones exist because the sun hits different parts of the Earth at different times. You can watch a lunar eclipse and see a round shadow. Flights between Southern Hemisphere cities take routes that only make sense on a globe. Thousands of independent pilots, sailors, and amateur astronomers, with no reason to coordinate a lie, all report things consistent with a round Earth and inconsistent with a flat one. If you want, pick one of these and we can dig into it together.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it's actually every color mixed together. When that light hits our atmosphere, it crashes into tiny molecules of gas, way smaller than a wavelength of light. Blue light has a short, choppy wave, so it bounces off those molecules way more easily than red or yellow light, which have longer, lazier waves. So as sunlight pours through the sky, blue light gets scattered all over the place, bouncing around in every direction, while the other colors mostly just pass straight through. Look up, and you're seeing all that scattered blue light coming at you from every direction at once. It's also why sunsets turn orange and red: the light is traveling through more atmosphere, so even the blue gets scattered away before it reaches you, leaving the longer wavelengths behind.

## 4

雨夜的街灯晕成一片朦胧的黄，雨丝斜斜地织着，打在伞面上沙沙作响。路上行人不多，脚步声混着水声，显得格外清晰。路边的水洼映着灯光，一圈一圈的波纹荡开又消失。远处偶尔驶过一辆车，车灯扫过湿漉漉的柏油路，留下一道亮晶晶的痕迹。空气里有雨水和泥土混合的味道，凉凉的，让人清醒。窗内有人坐着看书，窗外的雨声成了唯一的背景音，安静得让人忘了时间。
